reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that moves filesystem and subprocess execution into an E2B remote sandbox with workspace synchronization, heartbeat keep-alive, and recovery.

summaries.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 的文件系统和子进程执行迁移到支持保持、恢复及工作区同步的 E2B 远程沙箱中。
summaries.en: Moves DeepSeek Harness filesystem and subprocess execution into an E2B remote sandbox with keep-alive, recovery, and workspace synchronization.

capabilities: Executes subprocesses in an E2B remote sandbox
Provides remote filesystem operations for the DeepSeek Harness context
Synchronizes workspace data into and out of the remote sandbox
Maintains, resumes, or recreates sandbox sessions after connection failures
Uses an E2B API key to manage sandbox lifecycle
